title: SARS-CoV-2 Virus Plaque Assays in Biosafety Level 3
author: tenOever Lab
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bdtni6me

steps.title: Prepare Modified DMEM
steps.instruction: Prepare modified DMEM [DMEM with 2% FBS] by mixing the following components: 475 mL DMEM (w/ L-Glutamate, Sodium pyruvate), 5 mL 100x P/S, 5 mL 100x Non-Essential Amino Acids (NEAA) Solution, 5 mL 1M HEPES, and 10 mL FBS.

steps.title: Prepare 2XMEM
steps.instruction: Prepare 2XMEM and sterile filter using a 22 μm filtration unit. Mix 100 mL 10x MEM, 10 mL 100x P/S, 10 mL 100x L-Glutamine, 6 mL 35%BSA, 340 mL sterile ddH2O, 10 mL 1M HEPES, and 24 mL 5% NaHCO3.

steps.title: Prepare Overlay Media
steps.instruction: Prepare the Overlay Media by mixing 1 mL PBS, 31.5 mL 2X MEM, and 17.5 mL Oxoid Agar.

steps.title: Seed Vero E6 Cells
steps.instruction: Seed Vero E6 cells in 6-well plates at a density of 10^6 cells/well and incubate overnight at 37 °C.

steps.title: Dilute SARS-CoV-2 Virus
steps.instruction: Perform logarithmic dilutions of the SARS-CoV-2 virus in infection media.

steps.title: Infect Cells
steps.instruction: Replace the existing media with modified DMEM and add 200 µl/well of the diluted virus to each well.

steps.title: Allow Virus Adsorption
steps.instruction: Allow the virus to adsorb for 1 hour, agitating the plate every 10 minutes.

steps.title: Apply Overlay and Incubate
steps.instruction: Heat the overlay media/oxoid agar mixture to ensure homogenous consistency (ensure it is only warm to the touch when added). Add 2 ml/well to each well and incubate in a 37 °C incubator for 72 hours.

steps.title: Fix and Stain Plate
steps.instruction: Fix the plate to ensure virus inactivation and stain to determine viral titers (PFU/ml).

substeps.instruction: Fix with 5% formaldehyde (w/ methanol) at 1.5 ml/well overnight.
Stain with crystal violet for 1 hour.
